data.name: Cherianne
data.gender_notes: Cherianne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Cherianne is derived from the Greek and Latin words 'cheros' and 'aner', respectively, which mean 'dear' and 'man'. In the context of female names, 'Cherianne' conveys a sense of grace and tenderness, reflecting the nurturing and caring qualities often associated with women. The name Cherianne carries the meaning “Graceful, dear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cherianne usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the spirit of kindness and compassion
data.etymology: Cherianne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, dear one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cherianne total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Χεριαννη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χεριαννη προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις Χερία που σημαίνει χριστιανή κοπέλα και αννη που σημαίνει αγία και καθαρή. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με την πίστη και την αγιότητα.

in_latin.name: Cherianne

in_english.name: Cherianne
in_english.meaning: A Christian girl, holy and pure in Christ
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cherianne is a combination of two words that signify a Christian girl who is holy and pure in Christ. Etymologically, it stems from Hebrew and Greek roots, connoting sanctity and purity. Historically, the name has been used in Christian tradition to denote a person of faith and spiritual cleanliness. It symbolizes a life devoted to God and virtuous living.
